notes.title: Announcing two new Frictional Games bundles!
notes.content:
[h1]We just launched TWO new Frictional Games bundles on Steam![/h1]

These are curated for you who would like to explore more of the same themes - without having to buy all games at once. Two bundles with focus on Frictional's most favorite things - [b]stories[/b] and [b]horror[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41033/Frictional_Survival_Horror_Collection/][b]Frictional Survival Horror Collection:[/b][/url]
A collection of the most Survival Horror heavy Frictional Games titles. Put your brave face on and embrace terror.

[i]Bundle includes:[/i][list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/32031/][b]Penumbra Collectors Pack[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/57300/Amnesia_The_Dark_Descent/][b]Amnesia: The Dark Descent[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1944430/Amnesia_The_Bunker/][b]Amnesia: The Bunker[/b][/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41032/Frictional_Story_Rich_Collection/][b]Frictional Story-Rich Collection[/b][/url]
A selected collection for you who enjoy tales of psychological horror and existential dread. 

[i]Bundle includes:[/i][list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/239200/Amnesia_A_Machine_for_Pigs/][b]Amnesia: A Machine For Pigs[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/282140/SOMA/][b]SOMA[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/999220/Amnesia_Rebirth/][b]Amnesia: Rebirth[/b][/url][/list]
Buy these bundles and get an extra[b] 15% off![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41033/Frictional_Survival_Horror_Collection/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41032/Frictional_Story_Rich_Collection/
